subchannels.name: Duplicity and Social Shame

subchannels.active_motifs: two-faced duplicity `و ج ه:B015/m01`; shamelessness or weak protective jealousy `ل ي س:B008/m01`; loss of integrity or malformed conduct `و ض ع:B012/m02`; abusive or vain utterance `ل غ و:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Social disgrace emerges where divided presentation, defective restraint, and injurious speech expose a failure of character.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A person rejects rightful orientation through pride, disbelief, or disavowal and thereby enters a corresponding field of blame and punishment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Inner self-magnification, denial of benefit, broken allegiance, grave offense, and social duplicity become stages or expressions of refusal.

parent_channels.name: Body Morphology and Sensory Anatomy

subchannels.name: Eye, Ear, and Brain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sensory openings receive sight and sound while connected hollows and inner tissue support perception.
subchannels.active_motifs: eye or pupil `ن ظ ر:B008/m01`; ear as hearing organ `س م ع:B002/m02`; brain or head interior `س م ع:B016/m01`; eye socket or hollow `ع ي ن:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Perception is grounded in an anatomical route from exposed sensory opening to protected interior.

subchannels.name: Flesh, Muscle, and Bone Covering
subchannels.scene_or_process: Soft tissue, muscle, membrane, and enclosing bone define layers of bodily structure.
subchannels.active_motifs: fleshy buttock `ء ل ي:B015/m01`; calf muscle `ح م ي:B009/m01`; periosteum or bony covering `ض ر ع:B012/m02`; chest or rib enclosure `ج ن ن:B016/m01`; thick-set body `ج ب ل:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The body appears as nested structural layers whose density and covering determine shape and strength.

subchannels.name: Proportion, Crease, and Marking
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body is recognized by relative dimensions, linear creases, colored variation, and distinctive facial marks.
subchannels.active_motifs: head-neck proportion `ك و ب:B006/m01`; palm or forehead lines `س ر ر:B009/m01`; variegated bodily marking `ح س ب:B009/m02`; white facial blaze `غ ش و:B007/m02`; thin or misshapen body `س م ع:B012/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 88:14 `أكواب` (`ك و ب`); 88:13 `سرر` (`س ر ر`); 88:26 `حسابهم` (`ح س ب`); 88:1 `الغاشية` (`غ ش و`); 88:11 `تسمع` (`س م ع`)
subchannels.synthesis: Proportion and surface inscription operate together as a vocabulary for identifying bodily form.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodily parts are identified by their cavities, coverings, proportions, markings, and sensory functions.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Eye and ear anatomy extends into brain, muscle, bone covering, body proportion, skin pattern, and facial marking.

parent_channels.name: Hunting and Wild Fauna

subchannels.name: Hunt, Trap, and Blind
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hunter seeks game, works an implement, and channels the animal toward a snare or concealed enclosure.
subchannels.active_motifs: hunting expedition or implement `ط ع م:B006/m01`; seeking game `س م و:B006/m01`; snare or trap `ص ل ي:B005/m01`; hunting blind or animal pen `ز ر ب:B001/m02`; working forelimb `ع م ل:B010/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 88:6 `طعام` (`ط ع م`); 88:18 `السماء` (`س م و`); 88:4 `تصلى` (`ص ل ي`); 88:16 `زرابي` (`ز ر ب`); 88:3 `عاملة` (`ع م ل`)
subchannels.synthesis: Pursuit, concealment, channeling, and capture compose a single hunting operation.

subchannels.name: Ostrich and Quail
subchannels.scene_or_process: Wild birds are distinguished by species, bodily form, and resemblance to familiar animal shapes.
subchannels.active_motifs: ostrich `ن ع م:B006/m01`; ostrich-shaped form `ن ع م:B007/m02`; quail `س م ن:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 88:8 `ناعمة` (`ن ع م`); 88:7 `يسمن` (`س م ن`)
subchannels.synthesis: Species naming and shape comparison create a compact field of ground-dwelling game birds.

subchannels.name: Carnivore Cub
subchannels.scene_or_process: A young predator is classified by species, age, and emerging male strength.
subchannels.active_motifs: wolf or hyena cub `س م ع:B010/m01`; maleness and strength `ذ ك ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 88:11 `تسمع` (`س م ع`); 88:21 `فذكر`, `مذكر` (`ذ ك ر`)
subchannels.synthesis: The specialized animal term combines juvenile status with the anticipated force of the mature predator.

subchannels.name: Goat and Separated Young Stock
subchannels.scene_or_process: Young animals are identified, divided from the main herd, and managed as a distinct group.
subchannels.active_motifs: young goat `س ط ر:B007/m01`; separated young livestock `و ل ي:B015/m02`; herd group `ء ب ل:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Age classification becomes a management practice when young stock are sorted from the larger herd.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Animals outside ordinary domestic use are pursued, trapped, classified, or distinguished by age and form.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Hunting implements and blinds connect the camel scene to ostrich, quail, predator cubs, and separated young stock.

parent_channels.name: S1. Chessboard Play
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Players arrange a bounded game position and move pieces within it.
parent_channels.active_motifs: chessboard play or chess piece `ك و ب:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: A specialized game sense forms a self-contained activity distinct from the vessel and body-shape channels.

parent_channels.name: S2. Termite, Dry Wood, and Bundled Fuel
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Dry timber is gathered for fuel while a ground-dwelling insect consumes the same material.
parent_channels.active_motifs: termite or earth creature `ء ر ض:B010/m01`; dry tree wood `ج ب ل:B008/m01`; bundled firewood `ء ب ل:B005/m02`; ignition or kindling `ص ل ي:B004/m04`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 88:20 `الأرض` (`ء ر ض`); 88:19 `الجبال` (`ج ب ل`); 88:17 `الإبل` (`ء ب ل`); 88:4 `تصلى` (`ص ل ي`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Wood joins insect habitat, gathered fuel, and combustion in a compact material cycle.

parent_channels.name: S3. Truffle Beneath Sandy Soil
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A truffle forms beneath a sandy surface and is recognized or extracted through its outer rind and ground sign.
parent_channels.active_motifs: truffle or rind in soil `س ر ر:B013/m01`; sandy ridge habitat `س ر ر:B015/m02`; productive earth `ء ر ض:B002/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: Hidden growth, protective surface, and sandy terrain make one specialized gathering scene.

parent_channels.name: S4. Ceremonial Crowning and Marriage
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A prominent bride is adorned and crowned as a marriage is publicly marked.
parent_channels.active_motifs: ceremonial crown `ك ف ر:B015/m01`; marriage union `غ ن ي:B006/m02`; socially prominent woman `غ ن ي:B005/m03`; eye-catching adornment `ع ي ن:B016/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: Status, ornament, and union converge in the visible rite that distinguishes the bride.

parent_channels.name: S5. Rivalrous Sexual Commerce
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Competing solicitors seek patrons and attempt to match or surpass one another in a commercial sexual setting.
parent_channels.active_motifs: prostitution or sexual commerce `س ع ي:B007/m01`; matched rivalry `س م و:B007/m02`; keeping pace or circulating `ج ر ي:B007/m02`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 88:9 `لسعيها` (`س ع ي`); 88:18 `السماء` (`س م و`); 88:12 `جارية` (`ج ر ي`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Solicitation becomes a competitive market activity through pursuit, comparison, and circulation.

parent_channels.name: S6. Strong and Diluted Drink
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A drink is served in a cup and adjusted between concentrated strength and a thinned or cooled state.
parent_channels.active_motifs: strong or heated drink `ح م ي:B008/m01`; thin or diluted drink `ض ر ع:B011/m02`; drinking cup `ك و ب:B005/m02`; cooling or tempering `س م ن:B003/m02`
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 88:4 `حامية` (`ح م ي`); 88:6 `ضريع` (`ض ر ع`); 88:14 `أكواب` (`ك و ب`); 88:7 `يسمن` (`س م ن`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Vessel, concentration, dilution, and temperature define one bounded process of beverage preparation.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.
